slices.title: Vocabulary, variants, taxonomy gate
slices.summary: Adds the closed lifecycle vocabulary (mp-contracts lifecycle_notice.rs with strict flag MODEL_GATEWAY_LIFECYCLE_EVENTS, default false), three typed ChatEvent variants (retry_scheduled in the steps family; compaction and context_change as control events), the taxonomy regeneration, SPA handlers, AG-UI CUSTOM entries and the D1 ledger entry. Payloads are counts and closed tokens only; no proto, no migration.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p mp-contracts && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --lib sse_events
pnpm exec vitest run src/shared/api/chat-client.test.ts src/shared/chat/verevon-ui-events.test.ts (run in apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3; verevon-ui-events.test.ts does not exist at HEAD)
cargo test --manifest-path apps/gateway/Cargo.toml --all-targets (run in apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3)
if WS12 S7 landed: MP_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p model-gateway --lib sse_event_payload_golden, then sync the script
slices.notes: Do NOT edit these shared files (the lead applies your exact lines after the batch; put them in lead_todo as 'shared-edit <file>: <exact lines>'): apps/Model Plane/docs/decisions/ledger.md

slices.title: Frame, screen and count-only persist connector results (code half)
slices.summary: Adds a ConnectorContent trust class kept in step between execution-core and model-gateway, maps the provider read and execute tools to it, and persists only structured counts for connector results. Provider tools are audited as personal, and connector_read is refused under ZDR in both loops with its matrix rows re-pinned. Tightening only: no new tool is offered.
slices.remaining: Code half: Frame, screen and count-only persistence of connector results with mocked-provider tests.
